abstract.t: The Intelligent Architecture Transfer Protocol (IATP) is a lightweight, stateful, zero-copy transport protocol designed for deterministic communication between Intelligent Agents (IA), local inference runtimes, hardware edge controllers, and federated knowledge nodes. Operating natively over TCP port 7027 (cleartext local/intranet) and TLS port 443 (federated), IATP pairs a three- phase T-Pipe multiplexer with Length-Prefix Chunk Framing and the Intelligent Agent Markup Language (IaML) to achieve O(n) single-pass stream routing without head-of-line blocking, recursive tree allocation, or patent-based encumbrances.
